decisions.question: 为何不把功能命名为配置传感器？
decisions.basis: that specifies a candidate component and does not state what must be accomplished
decisions.choice: establish local surface reference; biological boundary remains unknown

decisions.question: 功能分解何时停止？
decisions.choice: when alternatives and interfaces can be examined in this limited research problem, not at a prescribed depth

decisions.question: 异常后能自动恢复吗？
decisions.choice: no evidence permits it; explicit human reauthorization is a teaching control choice, not a verified safety solution

alternative_decomposition.difference: same responsibilities may be grouped differently; operational scenarios and traceability remain necessary
